audit.whatIsWrong: The prose says levels 1-2 are yours because 'your Cannon Q already out-ranges his Bouncing Bomb'. It does not, and the chart on the same page already gives Level 1 to Ziggs.
audit.why: Riot ranges: Shock Blast 600, Bouncing Bomb 850. Ungated, he out-ranges you by 250 units. The Acceleration Gate is what buys the range — which is why the page's own spikes entry correctly puts the swing at 2-3 and why win[0] says Ziggs. The advice as written sends you to stand in front of a longer-ranged mage at level 1.
audit.corrected: Ziggs out-ranges the raw orb; the gate is what flips it.

audit.why: Spikes at 2-3 (Acceleration Gate), 6 (Mega Inferno Bomb, 120s at rank 1), first item and late are correctly placed, and each names the mechanic causing the shift rather than the level.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge is described only as something that knocks YOU out of a dive, and Short Fuse never appears at all.
audit.why: Riot's text: the Satchel explosion knocks Ziggs away as well, taking no damage — so it is his escape, not only his peel, and burning it to stop your dive costs him his exit for up to 20 seconds. Short Fuse periodically empowers his next basic attack and its cooldown is reduced every time he casts an ability, so a Ziggs who has just thrown bombs has the empowered auto ready.
audit.corrected: Name the self-knockback as his escape and Short Fuse as the cast-fed auto.

edits.before: Your Cannon Q (Shock Blast) out-ranges his Bouncing Bomb and he has no sustain to heal the chip you stack on him.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb out-ranges your ungated Cannon Q by 850 to 600 — level 1 is his, so farm and wait for the gate.

edits.before: Even before the gate is online your raw Cannon Q range beats his step-up poke, and he has no tool to punish you back at level 2.
edits.after: At 2 your raw Shock Blast is still 250 units short of his bomb, so bank the E point rather than trading into his range.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are yours. Your Cannon Q (Shock Blast) already out-ranges his Bouncing Bomb, and once you point Acceleration Gate at 2-3 the gate-boosted orb gains bonus range, speed and damage that beat everything he has before his Satchel exists. Stand on the wave and fire gate-Q every time he walks up to last-hit — his bombs chip but he has no sustain and no escape, so if he over-steps you swap to Hammer and To-the-Skies + Thundering Blow him under your tower. Do NOT dive past minions onto his Q at even health; bait the Satchel knockback first, then commit the kill.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are not free. Ungated, his Bouncing Bomb out-ranges Shock Blast 850 to 600, so farm the back of the wave and wait. Once you point Acceleration Gate at 2-3 the boosted orb gains bonus range, speed and damage and beats everything he has before his Satchel exists. Then fire gate-Q every time he walks up to last-hit — his bombs chip but he has no sustain and no escape, so if he over-steps you swap to Hammer and To-the-Skies + Thundering Blow him under your tower. Do NOT dive past minions onto his Q at even health; bait the Satchel knockback first, then commit the kill.
